original_ai_output.title_zh: 南非12名女性遇害后宣布整治高风险地区
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南非总统拉马福萨宣布在全国高风险地区开展清理整治行动。此前两个月内，约翰内斯堡以东地区发现12名女性遗体，引发全国对性别暴力规模的强烈愤慨。拉马福萨称已就此案逮捕4人，但警方尚未发现证据表明这些凶杀系单一凶手所为。

key_facts.fact: 南非总统拉马福萨宣布在全国高风险地区开展清理整治行动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: South Africa's President Cyril Ramaphosa on Tuesday announced a clean-up of high-risk areas across the country

key_facts.fact: 两个月内在约翰内斯堡以东地区发现12名女性遗体
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the bodies of 12 women were discovered in an area east of Johannesburg in just two months

key_facts.fact: 相关凶杀案已有4人被捕
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the murders, for which there have been four arrests

key_facts.fact: 警方尚未发现证据表明这些凶杀系单一凶手所为
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: At present, the police have not found evidence establishing that these killings were committed by a single perpetrator.

key_facts.fact: 南非人权委员会称4月至6月间569名女性被杀、1052人遭谋杀未遂后幸存
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: 569 women were killed and 1,052 others survived attempted murder between April and June this year

uncertainties: 警方尚未证实这些凶杀是否由单一凶手实施
